description: Lights On proposes maintenance, reviews PRs and publishes authorized changes across Actions/admission/state, inference/workers, maintenance/review, publication/releases, protected local execution, the npm demo, and adoption/site. All seven families and helpers remain in scope. Neither model judgment nor passing tests proves semantic safety. This unratified export is lossy and is never a triage input; THREAT_MODEL.md > YAML > JSON. Prior-promise conflicts remain non-closing; dependency-contract has no JSON label and falls through to model_gap. No new ratification or acceptance occurred.

out_of_scope.reason: GitHub host/control-plane compromise; not project privilege misuse
Malicious local administrator/kernel/Docker; hostile shared runners need stronger isolation
Live cloud services, host devices, native non-Linux workers; synthetic loopback remains covered
GitHub Enterprise publication unsupported; wrong-target acceptance remains covered

trust_boundaries.boundary: Actions analysis/mutation share job rights; withholding a step environment variable is not isolation. SDK client is controller TCB; empty mode restricts its child. Local roles and release jobs have separate boundaries. Reachability requires A admission, B tool selection, C lane selection, D authorized publication, E operator invocation, F prepared target or G adoption/deployment. Data-induced authority acquisition remains an attack.
